name: ALERT
description: ALERT is a large-scale benchmark designed to assess the safety of large language models (LLMs) through red teaming methodologies. It uses a novel fine-grained risk taxonomy and consists of more than 45,000 instructions to identify vulnerabilities and evaluate alignment with safety policies.
reputation: A recent large-scale safety benchmark that is gaining attention for fine-grained red-teaming evaluation of LLM alignment and harmful instruction handling.
notes: Focuses on safety evaluation through adversarial testing and fine-grained risk taxonomy.
